question: In relation to which two mouths must the ritual elements be pleased and made supreme?
premises: This concerns the mouths of Śiva and fire.
inference: Having pleased and made them supreme, one acts in relation to the mouths of Śiva and fire.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of śiva+vaktra in the compound chain is compressed and context-dependent.
plain_english: Having pleased and made them supreme, one should do so in relation to the mouths of Śiva and fire.
